Page Header

The page header owns this page’s only h1 and description. Its named actions slot admits the GoLinks-owned dashboard link; navigation remains app-owned.

Layout components

Six neutral layout components arrange admitted child markup. Their responsive behavior comes from package components, not app-authored layout CSS.

Container and Stack

A reading-width region with generous gutters and a standard vertical rhythm. The outer container keeps long copy comfortable.

Compact spacing, centered alignment.

Cluster: paired actions

Default child markup remains the card body. This card uses the component’s native heading level.

Card padding and heading level are explicit options.

Cards compose within a responsive grid without custom wrappers.

The start region is deliberately wider on large containers, then stacks before it gets cramped.

Named regions preserve source order. This narrow column demonstrates container-driven recovery.

Avatar

Named identities with initials fallback. Initials-only examples are sample people, not accounts. HTTPS images load directly in the browser; the server does not fetch them.

Empty State

An empty result explains what is missing and offers admitted navigation. These examples are illustrative; the live list below uses the same component when no links match.

Metric

Illustrative formatted values, not current GoLinks totals. Direction and favorability are independent: a falling error rate is positive, while rising errors are negative. No metric is a live announcement.

Skeleton

Decorative loading shapes, always hidden from assistive technology. The app supplies the busy region and meaningful loading text. These are illustrative placeholders, not an actual pending request.

Loading sample content (illustrative). Reduced motion removes the animation.

Static placeholders

Form Field

The component owns the label, control, and accessible descriptions. GoLinks owns the form and command.

Create a test link

This submits the existing GoLinks create command. Use a unique name; it creates a real link in this local instance.

Review states

Native input types

Tag

Metadata is distinct from operational status. Linked tags navigate; a removal affordance is an app-owned destination, not client-side dismissal.

The sample filter link returns to this section; it does not remove data.

Alert

These are illustrative messages, not current GoLinks incidents. Announcements are opt-in; these static examples do not interrupt assistive technology.

Progress

Illustrative task data. Determinate values are checked, not clamped. Unknown progress uses a native indeterminate element, not a fake percentage.
